# Synthetic OBS-05 fixture: production service environment.
OTEL_SERVICE_NAME=checkout
OTEL_TRACES_SAMPLER=always_on
OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT=http://collector:4317

FROM python:3.12-slim AS base
WORKDIR /app

FROM base AS production
ENV OTEL_TRACES_SAMPLER_ARG=0.1
CMD ["python", "-m", "app"]

services:
  api:
    image: example/api:1.4
    environment:
      OTEL_TRACES_SAMPLER: traceidratio
      OTEL_TRACES_SAMPLER_ARG: "1.0"
  worker:
    image: example/worker:1.4
    environment:
      - OTEL_TRACES_SAMPLER=parentbased_always_on
      - OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT=http://collector:4317

AWSTemplateFormatVersion: "2010-09-09"
Resources:
  CatchAllRule:
    Type: AWS::XRay::SamplingRule
    Properties:
      SamplingRule:
        RuleName: catch-all
        Priority: 100
        FixedRate: 1.0
        ReservoirSize: 1
        ServiceName: "*"
        ServiceType: "*"
        Host: "*"
        HTTPMethod: "*"
        URLPath: "*"
        ResourceARN: "*"
        Version: 1
  CheckoutRule:
    Type: AWS::XRay::SamplingRule
    Properties:
      SamplingRule:
        Priority: 10
        FixedRate: 1
        ReservoirSize: 5
        ServiceName: checkout
        ServiceType: "*"
        Host: "*"
        HTTPMethod: "*"
        URLPath: "*"
        ResourceARN: "*"
        Version: 1
  ApiFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    Properties:
      Runtime: python3.12
      Environment:
        Variables:
          OTEL_TRACES_SAMPLER: always_on

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: checkout
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: checkout
          image: example/checkout:2.0
          env:
            - name: OTEL_TRACES_SAMPLER
              value: always_on
